project_context.theme: Cosmic Dark (Default) with Light Mode Toggle
project_context.persona: Mohammed Abzan - Administration & Customer Service Professional

rules: No Inter or generic sans for headings. Use Unbounded for a bold, cosmic, premium look.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for massive hero texts.
Limit hero heading max text-6xl with fluid clamp scaling. No text-9xl.
Use tinting: Never use pure black #000000. Always tint it slightly blue/purple (e.g., #03040B).
Gradients are for decorative borders and nodes, not full screen backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 (Dark) or bg-white/70 (Light) with 1px border-white/10. NO FULLY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUNDS.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Emerald/Amber drop shadows and radial gradients for interactive nodes and hover states.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay globally to kill digital flatness.

hero.details: Massive 'MOHAMMED ABZAN' typography. Masked line-by-line reveal on load. Dynamic rotating role text. Avatar is a geometric cosmic face where eyes/face follow the mouse via Framer Motion.

about.details: Asymmetric layout: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12. Floating cards with hover tilt (rotateX/Y) physics and glowing tracing beam borders. Use generative cargo/airport night imagery as deep backgrounds.

experience.details: Floating timeline cards acting like bubbles. On hover, they ripple/expand. High physics-based motion rather than static lists.

skills.details: Cosmic background. Skills nodes shoot across the canvas and lock into categorized badges (Technical, Soft, Tools).

marquee.details: Numbered manifesto chapters drifting slowly. Large outline text in the background to provide kinetic texture.

motion_and_libraries.animations: Framer Motion for scroll reveals, hover tilts, bubble physics, and avatar eye-tracking.

hero_avatar_inspiration.description: Neon geometric cosmic astronaut. Use for avatar/hero inspiration.

experience_bg.description: Airport cargo night ops for bento grid or experience backdrop.

skills_particles.description: Emerald glowing stars for skills cosmic canvas backdrop.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .js/.jsx extensions for all React components, not .tsx.
Implement a Dark/Light mode toggle that flips the cosmic theme to a bright, clean glass aesthetic seamlessly.
For the cursor-tracking avatar, use framer-motion's usePointer/useTransform to map mouse X/Y to eye/face rotateX/Y values up to ±15 degrees.
Integrate Lenis for smooth scroll. Wrap the main app layout with it.
Do NOT build a Projects section. Skip it entirely as per requirements.
Forms must have validation and success states using react-hook-form + sonner for toasts.
Use 'react-fast-marquee' for the slow editorial ribbon.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' centralized designs. Embrace tension, overlapping elements, and asymmetry.
Do NOT apply universal transitions like 'transition: all'. It breaks Framer Motion transforms. Target specific properties.
Do NOT center align the entire app container (.App { text-align: center }). Use proper grid/flex alignments.
Generous spacing: Use p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped UIs. Containers with borders need ample padding.
All interactive elements MUST have explicit hover/focus state colors to guarantee contrast.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns. Always use solid or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-btn').
